Who dares say that Belgrave's road team is not becoming well known?!----after working on his car, Ray Beaumont left rather hurriedly for this race with his number plates still on the back seat.

Ray Beaumont was a deserved second and that popular "vet" Joe McDonald third. Joe was delighted at being amongst the prizes and also at beating his training companion, the evergreen Charlie Smart; though he would probably agree that their handicap allowances should have been reversed on pre-race form.
Nice to see two sons of Club members, Ivan Beaumont (son of Ray) and Stephen Walker (son of Chas.) running for the Club in the K.L.G. 3000 metres Cross-Country races for colts recently.
